# appleads_product_pages (Data Source)

Lists custom product pages for an App Store app via Apple Ads `GET /apps/{adamId}/product-pages`.

Custom product pages are owned and edited in [App Store Connect](https://appstoreconnect.apple.com); the Ads API is **read-only** here. Use returned `id` values when creating creatives/ads.

Optional `name` and `states` (`VISIBLE`, `HIDDEN`) filter the list. An empty result is valid (no matching pages), not an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appleads_product_pages" "visible" {
  adam_id = "899247964"
  states  = ["VISIBLE"]
}

output "product_page_ids" {
  value = [
    for page in data.appleads_product_pages.visible.product_pages : page.id
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `adam_id` (String) Adam ID (App Store identifier) of the app whose product pages to list.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Filter by custom product page name as configured in App Store Connect.
- `states` (List of String) Filter by visibility state. Allowed values: `VISIBLE`, `HIDDEN`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite id of the list parameters (`adam_id` plus optional filters).
- `product_pages` (Attributes List) Matching product pages (may be empty). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--product_pages))

<a id="nestedatt--product_pages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `product_pages`

Read-Only:

- `adam_id` (String) Adam ID of the app owning the page.
- `creation_time` (String) Creation timestamp from Apple Ads.
- `deep_link` (String) Deep link from App Store Connect product page metadata, when set.
- `id` (String) Product page UUID from App Store Connect (used when creating creatives).
- `modification_time` (String) Last modification timestamp from Apple Ads.
- `name` (String) Custom product page display name.
- `state` (String) `VISIBLE` or `HIDDEN`.
